newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hotelier Huandao applies to issue 31 mln A shares.
newsitem.headline: Hotelier Huandao applies to issue 31 mln A shares.

text.p: Hotelier Hainan Huandao Industrial Co Ltd has applied to the China Securities Regulatory Commission for an offer of 31 million A shares for listing in Shenzhen, a company spokesman said on Friday.

The company, which owns a five-star hotel in Haikou, capital of Hainan province, expects to receive the CSRC's approval to make the offer in the near future, he told the Hong Kong-based China Securities Bulletin newsletter.
Shenzhen Guotou Securities Co Ltd has been appointed to underwrite Huandao's A share issue, the official said.

Huandao, which also operates some entertainment facilities in Haikou, aims to channel the A share proceeds into its main operations and into the construction of a hydroelectric power plant in Sichuan, he said.
Huandao forecast net profits of 43 million yuan for 1997 against an unaudited 39 million yuan in 1996 and 24 million yuan in 1995, he said.
The firm has total share capital of 89.60 million shares, composed of 64 million legal person shares and 25.60 million staff shares.

The official also said that China Huandao Group Co, a conglomerate with a 53 percent equity stake in the hotelier, plans to apply to the CSRC to offer H shares -- stock issued by mainland Chinese firms for listing in Hong Kong --- by the end of 1997.

China Huandao, which is owned by the Ministry of Public Security, is among the 38 domestic enterprises newly selected by the Securities Commission of the State Council as candidates for listing abroad, he said.
The scale of China Huandao's H share offer is not yet fixed, the official said and gave no further details.
